items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: he had a good job for us. And he kind of wanted to come. He said he'd like to have me and Red and Sam and Charlie and Duff

ctx.x: But as far as some of these shows that you heard, Ted Lewis, Vincent Lopez and Paul Whiteman, Lester Young used to go listen to them, too?
Yeah, we used to... Another band we used to go listen to at that time, Coon and Sam.
Coon Saunders? Yeah, I've heard of them.
